scope: local optimization handoff only, not official competition execution

R-01.basis: Actual provided blocked source is compiled into parameterized semantic program/access rules. Immutable runtime interpretation determines dependencies, not hardcoded algorithm edges.

R-03.basis: Temporary scalar/wavefront and original-trace checks plus region-conflict oracle; does not claim arbitrary C++ or missing original scalar source coverage.

R-04.basis: Blocked workload optimized, scalar/generic paths preserved. No equal-performance claim for other algorithms.

R-05.basis: Same metadata across public and additional shapes; region IDs depend on actual geometry. Original vendor files unchanged; no case/seed/file-name table in graph/runtime.

R-06.basis: Same input, local machine and numerical archive, interleaved independent runs; baseline 0.484026138s vs P0050.295530587s in this comparison.

R-07.basis: Double full row-major n*n A/L with independent factor verification and public verifier.

R-08.basis: No default task/work cap. Exact final binary n=10000,b=100 passed known L=2I; n=512,b=1 completed22500866 semantic tasks through budget fallback. Not exhaustive all n/b.

R-09.basis: Public input b retained, including24/48/96; runtime rejects invalid shapes and does not change b.

R-10.basis: 20 matching ordered output case records, full matrix payload.

R-11.basis: Explicit original protocol, scalar and blocked CLI block parameters checked; different b rejected by comparison scope.

R-13.basis: Acceptance execute command invokes exactly two file arguments; submit launcher also passes exactly these to binary.

R-14.basis: Provided verifier exit0 and20PASS, no extra byte-identity gate.

R-15.basis: Finite inputs/outputs/intermediate residuals and strictly positive diagonal retained.

R-16.basis: Lossless generic encoding, both source and contract SHA256, actual read/write and control semantics; grid/CSR logic is not Cholesky-specific.

R-17.basis: main object undefined refs only public cholesky/trsm/madd; local supplied archive unchanged; actual external-archive branch rebuilt and both verifiers20PASS using clearly labeled demo archive. True judge library still absent.

R-18.basis: Single sequential case loop, no next-case prep overlap; same-size buffers/immutable metadata/pool reuse after drain; initial/cleanup costs timed.

R-19.basis: Process affinity intersects one node; no fixed24-core bound. Target CPU/memory placement not observed.

R-20.basis: Local x86-64 WSL2 Linux only. Ubuntu22.04/Kunpeng-920 not claimed verified.

R-21.basis: Global timer before configuration and metadata, subtract only matrix file I/O; numeric preparation/cleanup included; checker run afterward.

R-22.basis: Separate M and T Pareto; no invented score/rank or linear85*T+15*M.

R-23.basis: Tests anchored to source/requirements and independent conflicts/factors/verifier; temporary fixtures deleted, only existing benchmark persists.

R-24.basis: Actual metadata file bytes and SHA256 agree with retained artifact; size shown in summary.

R-25.basis: Exact P005 n150,b1 automatic >256MiB parallel, explicit256MiB resource fallback; actual memory limits remain respected; clean submit drops injected limits; same/different sizes ledger and no-false-trsm cases checked. Target remains unverified.

R-26.basis: Low cap fallback excludes affected case, full score ineligible; serial/parallel common intersection only; fatal8MiB sequence categories [completed_unvalidated,resource_failed,not_run] with no speed statistic; malformed/ordinary errors do not count as OOM.

remaining_external_validation: Ubuntu22.04 Kunpeng920 actual allowed NUMA performance
